input.subject: Bathroom tap – Flat 19, 159 Juniper Mews (ref R/PM033-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Re: Flat 19, 159 Juniper Mews, Kingshaven, ZZ9 2ZZ – ref R/PM033-1

Your landlord has agreed for us to instruct a plumber to look at the bathroom tap that squirts water when the shower is running. We are now arranging a contractor, who will contact you to agree a time to attend.

In the meantime, to limit any water damage:
- Keep shower use short and wipe up any water straight away.
- If there is a small isolation valve on the pipe under the tap, you can turn it a quarter turn to shut off water to that tap.
- If water starts escaping when the shower is off, or you can't stop it, turn off the water at the main stopcock and contact us immediately.

Could you reply with your availability for a visit over the coming days and any access considerations we should pass on?

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team
